WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.

3. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

4. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.

5. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.

6. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

8. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

9. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.

10. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Upholstery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Project Activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Design in Woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

3. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.

11. A — Information and Communication Technology

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
